name: Pölöskefő (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over light grey, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Pölöskefő: a blue shield with a white sheaf of grain and a wavy stripe, between green branches, above a yellow scroll inscribed PÖLÖSKEFŐ.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Pölöskefő arms with branches and scroll
